appDescription.message: Translates Hungarian web pages to English on your own machine, with Chrome’s built-in model. No API key, no quota, no server.

skippedBecause.message: Left in the original language because $1.

cardNeedsDownload.message: Translating this page needs a one-time $1 model download. After that it runs offline.

cardNeedsGesture.message: Chrome needs one click before it will download the language model.

errorNoPair.message: This browser has no built-in translator for $1. Desktop Chrome 138+ or Edge 148+ is required.

popupDownloadBlurb.message: Chrome keeps the language model on your own disk. It downloads once, then works offline and costs nothing.

popupHoverNote.message: Point at a phrase to see what it said.

stateNoAccessDetail.message: The extension has no access to this page.

modeAutoHint.message: Every foreign page is translated as it loads.

modeAllowlistHint.message: Only the sites you have marked below are translated.

modeManualHint.message: Nothing is translated until you ask, here or with the shortcut.

optionsBlurb.message: Translation runs on your own machine with the model built into Chrome. No API key, no quota, and no page text is ever sent to a server.

optionsThreshold.message: How sure it has to be

optionsThresholdHint.message: Applies to the built-in Hungarian check. Lower catches more pages, including mixed-language ones. Raise it if English pages are being translated by mistake. The default, 0.06, is deliberately permissive.

optionsAlwaysHint.message: One hostname per line. Subdomains are included.

optionsAttrsNote.message: Text that only appears on hover or inside empty form fields.

optionsHoverNote.message: Point at any translated phrase to see what it said.

optionsAutoDetect.message: Work out the page language automatically

optionsAutoDetectNote.message: Translates any language Chrome supports, not only the one chosen below. Needs Chrome's language detector.

pairReady.message: Ready — the model for this pair is already on your disk.

pairDownloadable.message: Supported — the model downloads the first time you use it.

pairDownloading.message: The model for this pair is downloading now.

pairUnsupported.message: This browser cannot translate this pair.

optionsGlossaryLabel.message: Leave these exactly as they are

optionsGlossaryHint.message: One term per line: brand names, product names, legal terms. A phrase that is nothing but a glossary term is never sent to the model at all; inside a longer sentence the term is shielded and put back afterwards. If the model loses it, the sentence is translated again without the shield rather than left with a marker in it.

optionsCacheNote.message: Navigation and repeated headings are translated once, which makes later pages on a site nearly instant.

optionsCacheLimitHint.message: Phrases. The least recently used are dropped first once the limit is passed.

optionsResetHint.message: Site lists, glossary and API key included. Remembered phrases are kept.

errorNoEngine.message: This browser has no built-in translator. Desktop Chrome 138 or later, or Edge 148 or later, is required.

unsupportedFork.message: $1 does not provide the translator that is built into Chrome. This extension needs desktop Chrome 138 or later, or Edge 148 or later.

unsupportedOld.message: This is $1 $2. The built-in translator arrived in Chrome 138 and Edge 148, so this version is too old.

unsupportedUnknown.message: $1 $2 should have the built-in translator but is not offering it. Check the built-in AI flags at chrome://flags, and that the drive holding your browser profile has room for the model.

skippedUnknownLanguage.message: “$1” is not a language this browser can translate.

errorCloudUnconfigured.message: No translation service is set up yet. Add one in the extension settings.

cloudTestOk.message: Works — “Jó napot kívánok!” came back as “$1”

cloudNeedsSetup.message: Set to use a translation service, but none is set up yet. Open All settings to add one.

cloudIsAnOption.message: A translation service can be used instead — see All settings.

engineAuto.message: The browser, or a service if it cannot

optionsEngineHint.message: Chrome 138+ and Edge 148+ have a translation model built in: free, offline, and nothing leaves your machine. Other browsers do not, and a service fills the gap there. A service also translates better than the built-in model, at the cost of sending page text to it.

providerDeeplHint.message: Good on Hungarian and fast. The free tier covers 500,000 characters a month; a key from deepl.com ending in :fx is a free one and is detected automatically.

providerOpenaiHint.message: The only option that reads like a person wrote it, because the model can be told about register and idiom. Slower and it costs per page, unless you point it at a model running on your own machine.

optionsApiKeyHint.message: Kept in this browser profile and used only by the extension's background page. It is never given to a web page, and never sent anywhere except the service you chose.

optionsOpenaiHint.message: Anything speaking the OpenAI chat-completions protocol works: OpenAI, Groq, Together, OpenRouter, or a local Ollama or LM Studio server at http://localhost:11434/v1, which needs no key and keeps everything on your machine.

optionsCloudPrivacy.message: While a service is in use, the text of the pages you translate is sent to it. That is the trade for better translation, and it is why the built-in model is preferred whenever it is available.
